name: Digital employee: sales assistant that qualifies and answers every lead
summary: Every lead from your website gets an AI score, is saved to your sheet and gets a personalized reply draft.
description: Works like a 24/7 junior sales rep: it reads what each contact writes in your website form, scores them from 1 to 10 by interest and urgency, logs them in Google Sheets, leaves a personalized reply draft in Gmail so you only review and send it, and alerts the team in Slack. Point your form at the webhook (fields nombre, email, empresa and mensaje).

name: Digital employee: customer support agent that sorts emails and drafts replies
summary: Every support email is classified by AI and a ready reply draft is left in Gmail.
description: Handles your support inbox the way a teammate would: it classifies every new email (question, issue, invoice, return, sales or other), writes a reply in the customer's language following your rules and leaves it as a draft in Gmail, in the same thread, for you to review and send. It also posts the case type in Slack. Edit the rules in the AI step with your hours, policies and tone.

name: Digital employee: bookkeeping assistant that logs supplier invoices
summary: Reads every invoice that arrives by email, extracts its data with AI and logs it for your accountant.
description: Does a bookkeeping assistant's job: when an email with a supplier invoice arrives, AI extracts supplier, tax ID, number, date, net amount, VAT, total and due date, logs it in your Google Sheets register and emails you a summary with what is due. Filter the trigger by your invoices label or sender so it only reads those.

name: Digital employee: recruiter that screens applications and answers every candidate
summary: Every application is scored by AI against your job post, logged in your sheet and the candidate gets an instant reply.
description: Takes the first screening off your plate: when someone applies through your form, AI compares their CV with the job requirements, gives a 1 to 10 score with strengths and open questions, logs them in Google Sheets, sends a confirmation email and alerts Slack about the best ones. Write the job requirements in the AI step and point your form at the webhook (fields nombre, email, puesto and cv).

name: Digital employee: executive assistant that prepares your day
summary: Every morning it reviews your calendar and emails you a summary with priorities and how to prepare each meeting.
description: Like a personal assistant: every weekday at 8:00 it reads today's events from your Google Calendar and emails you a clear summary with the agenda, free slots, what to prepare for each meeting and the three priorities it recommends. Pick your calendar and add your email in the last step.

name: Holded invoice for every Stripe sale
summary: When you get paid on Stripe, the invoice is created in Holded and sent to the customer.
description: Every completed Stripe Checkout payment creates an invoice in Holded with the customer and the amount before Spanish VAT (21%), and emails it from Holded. Check the line description and VAT rate if you sell at a different rate.

name: Website leads to Google Sheets with an email alert
summary: Saves every form submission from your website to a sheet and emails you right away.
description: Point your website form at the webhook URL. Each submission is added as a row in Google Sheets and you get an email with the details so you can reply fast.

name: Daily summary of unpaid invoices
summary: Every weekday morning you get an email listing the Holded invoices that are still unpaid.
description: Monday to Friday at 8:00 AM (Madrid time), it looks up unpaid invoices in Holded and emails you how many there are. Change the recipient to your own email.

name: New Holded customers in Google Sheets
summary: Every new Holded contact is added to a spreadsheet.
description: When you add a customer, supplier or lead in Holded, a row with their name, tax ID (NIF), email and phone is added to the sheet you choose.

name: Interested customer by email: HubSpot deal and a proposal for your approval
summary: AI spots emails from interested customers, creates the deal, drafts a proposal and asks for your approval before sending it.
description: When an email arrives, Claude decides whether it comes from an interested customer and extracts their name, company, need and budget. If it does, it creates the deal in HubSpot, drafts a proposal and emails you two links: approve or discard. The proposal is sent to the customer as a reply only if you approve it. Nothing goes out without your sign-off.

name: Online store: Holded invoice for every WooCommerce order
summary: Every new order in your WooCommerce store creates an invoice in Holded and sends it to the customer.
description: When a WooCommerce order comes in, it calculates the amount before Spanish VAT (21%), creates the invoice in Holded with the order's billing details and sends it to the customer's email. Adjust the VAT rate if you sell products at a different rate.

name: Clinics and practices: every Calendly appointment logged and confirmed
summary: Every appointment booked in Calendly is logged in your patient sheet, and the patient gets a confirmation email with instructions.
description: When someone books in Calendly, a row with their name, email and date is added to Google Sheets, and the patient receives a confirmation email with your address and what to bring. Edit the email text with your practice's details.

name: Shopify store: Holded invoice sent to the customer
summary: Every paid Shopify order creates its invoice in Holded and sends it to the customer.
description: When a customer pays for an order in your Shopify store, Calibra creates the invoice in Holded for the order amount and emails it from Holded. Adjust the VAT rate if you don't sell at Spain's standard 21%.

name: PrestaShop store: Holded invoice for every order
summary: Every new PrestaShop order is invoiced in Holded and you get an email alert.
description: Calibra watches your PrestaShop store for new orders, creates the invoice in Holded for the total paid and sends you an alert with the order reference.

name: Phone alert for every PrestaShop order
summary: Get a Telegram message for every new order in your store.
description: Receive the reference, amount and payment method of every new PrestaShop order on Telegram, so you can prepare the shipment without opening the dashboard.

name: WooCommerce orders in a spreadsheet
summary: Every new WooCommerce order is logged in Google Sheets.
description: Keep an always up-to-date sales log: every new order in your WooCommerce store adds a row to the sheet you choose, ready for your reports or your accountant.

name: Recover abandoned Shopify carts
summary: An hour after a cart is abandoned, the customer gets an email inviting them to complete their purchase.
description: When someone leaves a cart unfinished in Shopify, Calibra waits an hour and sends them a friendly email with the link to complete the purchase.

name: Failed Stripe payment: alert the customer and your team
summary: If a charge fails, the customer gets an email and your team gets a Slack alert.
description: Don't lose customers over an expired card: when Stripe can't collect a payment, Calibra asks the customer to update their payment method and posts a message in the Slack channel you choose.

name: New Stripe subscribers to your Mailchimp list
summary: Every new Stripe subscription adds the customer to a Mailchimp list.
description: Welcome your new paying customers with your Mailchimp campaigns: every new Stripe subscription adds their email to the audience you choose.

name: Verifactu: hash and QR code for every Holded invoice
summary: Every new Holded invoice gets its chained hash and its QR code from Spain's tax agency (AEAT).
description: For each new Holded invoice, Calibra calculates the chained hash of the registration record (Spain's Verifactu rules, RD 1007/2023), generates the AEAT verification URL and QR code, and saves everything to a spreadsheet. Enter your Spanish tax ID (NIF) in both Spain steps.

name: AI-written daily summary of the BOE for your industry
summary: Every morning, AI reads the day's BOE (Spain's Official State Gazette) and sends you only what affects your industry.
description: Ideal for accounting firms, advisors and law firms: Calibra fetches today's BOE (Spain's Official State Gazette) table of contents, AI picks out and explains in plain language the provisions that matter to your industry, and you get it by email at 8:00 AM.

name: Slack alert when the BOE publishes on a topic
summary: Alert your team in Slack when the BOE (Spain's Official State Gazette) publishes anything with the keywords you track.
description: Track the BOE (Spain's Official State Gazette) by keyword (for example "subvención" for grants, "convenio colectivo" for collective agreements, or your industry's name) and post a Slack message with the title and link of each new provision.

name: Clock-in reminder on working days only
summary: Every morning, reminds the team to clock in, except on public holidays in your region.
description: Every morning Calibra checks whether today is a public holiday in your Spanish region (comunidad autónoma) and, if it's a working day, posts the clock-in reminder to the team's Slack channel.

name: Onboard EU customers with their VAT number verified in VIES
summary: Checks the VAT number in VIES and, if it's valid, creates the customer in Holded.
description: Receive the customer's details from your website or CRM, check in the European Commission's VIES system that their VAT number is valid for intra-EU transactions and, only then, create them in Holded under their official registered name.

name: Google Forms responses to Clientify with a welcome email
summary: Every form response creates a contact in Clientify and sends them an email.
description: Turn your Google form into a lead source: every response creates the contact in Clientify and sends them a welcome email. In the first step, map your form's questions to the contact fields.

name: Typeform leads to HubSpot with a Slack alert
summary: Every Typeform response creates a contact in HubSpot and alerts the sales team.
description: Every time someone fills in your Typeform, Calibra creates the contact in HubSpot and posts a message in your sales Slack channel so nobody is slow to call them.

name: Jotform requests as people and deals in Pipedrive
summary: Every Jotform submission creates the person and their deal in Pipedrive.
description: Your Jotform quote requests land in Pipedrive automatically: Calibra creates the person with their email and phone and opens a deal for them in the pipeline you choose.

name: Calendly meetings in Clientify with a follow-up task
summary: Every meeting booked in Calendly creates the contact in Clientify and a task to prepare for it.
description: When a customer books a meeting in Calendly, Calibra adds them to Clientify and creates a task so the sales rep can prepare for the call.

name: Slack alert when a Calendly appointment is canceled
summary: Your team hears about every canceled appointment right away.
description: When a customer cancels a Calendly appointment, Calibra posts an alert with their name and email in your Slack channel, so you can free up the slot or call them.

name: SMS reminder before every appointment
summary: Sends the customer an SMS a few hours before their Google Calendar appointment.
description: Reduce no-shows at clinics, salons and repair shops: Calibra sends the customer an SMS via Twilio before every appointment in your calendar. Put the customer's phone number in the event's description or location.

name: Reply to Google reviews with AI and your approval
summary: AI drafts a reply to every new review, and you approve it before it's published.
description: For bars, restaurants, hotels and shops: for every new Google review, AI drafts a reply in your tone, emails it to you with a link to approve it and, if you approve, publishes it on your Google Business Profile.

name: Classify support emails with AI
summary: AI reads every incoming email, classifies it and alerts the right team in Slack.
description: Every new email in your support inbox is classified with AI (issue, invoice, order or question) and posted to Slack with a one-line summary, so everyone handles their own.

name: Save your email attachments to Google Drive
summary: Every attachment you receive in Gmail is saved automatically to a Drive folder.
description: Stop digging through your inbox for invoices and delivery notes: attachments from the emails you choose (by sender, subject or label) are saved automatically to a Google Drive folder.

name: Save Outlook attachments to OneDrive
summary: Every attachment you receive in Outlook is saved to a OneDrive folder.
description: For Microsoft 365 users: attachments from your Outlook emails are saved automatically to the OneDrive folder you choose, filtered by sender or file type.

name: Supplier invoice log read by AI
summary: AI reads the invoices you receive by email and logs the supplier, date, net amount, VAT and total.
description: Every email from your suppliers with an invoice goes through AI, which extracts the supplier's tax ID, the invoice number, date, net amount, VAT and total, and adds them to your purchase invoice ledger in Google Sheets.

name: Email orders to Excel, read by AI
summary: AI reads the orders you receive in Outlook and logs them in your Microsoft 365 Excel workbook.
description: If your customers place orders by email, AI extracts the customer, products, quantities and delivery date and adds them as a row to your Excel workbook in OneDrive or SharePoint.

name: Factorial time off on the team calendar
summary: Every vacation or time-off request in Factorial shows up in Google Calendar.
description: Everyone can see who's out: every new absence in Factorial creates an event on the shared calendar with the person's name, the type of absence and the dates.

name: Welcome and onboarding tasks for every new hire
summary: Every new hire in Factorial is announced in Slack and gets an onboarding card in Trello.
description: When you add someone in Factorial, Calibra welcomes them in the team channel and creates a Trello card with the checklist to prepare: equipment, access, training and contract.

name: Contract for e-signature with Signaturit for every new Factorial hire
summary: Every new Factorial employee receives their contract to sign with Signaturit.
description: When you add someone in Factorial, Calibra sends them the contract to sign electronically with Signaturit. Choose the contract PDF in the signature step.

name: Documents signed with Signaturit archived in Drive
summary: Every signed document is downloaded, saved to Drive and you get an email alert.
description: When all signers are done, Calibra downloads the signed document from Signaturit, saves it to the Google Drive folder you choose and sends you an alert saying who signed it.

name: Deal won in Clientify: customer and invoice in Holded
summary: When you win a deal in Clientify, the customer and a draft invoice are created in Holded.
description: Connect sales and invoicing: when you mark a deal as won in Clientify, Calibra creates the customer in Holded and a draft invoice for the deal amount, ready to review and issue.

name: Slack alert for every new HubSpot deal
summary: The sales team sees every new HubSpot deal in Slack.
description: Every deal created in HubSpot shows up in your Slack sales channel with its name and amount, so the whole team can follow the pipeline in real time.

name: Post your blog updates on LinkedIn, written by AI
summary: Every new article on your blog becomes a LinkedIn post.
description: Calibra watches the RSS feed of your blog or an industry source; for every new article, AI writes a LinkedIn post in your tone and publishes it with the link.

name: Every new WordPress post on Facebook and LinkedIn
summary: Automatically shares your new posts on your Facebook Page and on LinkedIn.
description: When you publish a post on your WordPress site, Calibra shares it on your Facebook Page and your company's LinkedIn page with its title and link.

name: Real estate: reply to every lead within a minute
summary: Every lead from your website goes into Clientify, gets an instant reply and the agent is notified.
description: Property leads go cold in minutes. With this template, every inquiry from your website or a listing portal (via webhook) creates the contact in Clientify, sends them an email about the property and alerts the agent on Telegram.

name: After-hours WhatsApp support with AI
summary: AI answers your customers' frequently asked questions on WhatsApp.
description: Connect your WhatsApp Business number and let AI instantly answer common questions (opening hours, prices, bookings, shipping) using your business information. Edit the instructions text with your own details.

name: Telegram bot that answers with AI
summary: A Telegram bot that uses AI to answer questions from your customers or your team.
description: Create your bot with BotFather, connect it, and AI will answer every message using the information you put in its instructions: opening hours, internal procedures, FAQs…

name: Daily ECB exchange rate in your spreadsheet
summary: Every day, logs the official euro exchange rate against the currency you choose.
description: If you buy or sell outside the eurozone, always have the European Central Bank's reference exchange rate at hand: every weekday a row with the date and rate is added to your Google Sheets spreadsheet.

name: Google Forms subscribers to your Acumbamail list
summary: Every form response adds the email address to your Acumbamail list.
description: Grow your email marketing list without copying and pasting: everyone who fills in your Google form is added to the Acumbamail list you choose.

name: New WooCommerce customers to Mailchimp
summary: Every new customer in your store is added to your Mailchimp audience.
description: When someone creates an account in your WooCommerce store, Calibra adds them with their name to the Mailchimp audience you choose, for your campaigns and automations.

name: Training schools: Zoom registration from your form
summary: Every Typeform sign-up registers the student for your Zoom session.
description: For training schools and trainers: everyone who signs up through your Typeform is registered for the Zoom webinar or meeting you choose and receives their join link from Zoom.

name: New Holded customers to your Mailchimp list
summary: Every new Holded customer is subscribed to your Mailchimp audience.
description: Keep your marketing lists in sync with your invoicing: every new contact you add in Holded is added to Mailchimp with their email.

name: Phone alerts when an automation fails
summary: If any automation fails, you get a Telegram message with the step and the error.
description: Sleep easy: if any automation in the project fails, Calibra sends you a Telegram message with its name, the step that failed, the error explained and a link to review it.

name: Email alert for every new record in a table
summary: When a record is added to a Calibra table, you get an email.
description: Use Calibra tables as a lightweight database (issues, bookings, requests) and get an email every time a new record is added.

name: Send an email for every new Google Sheets row
summary: Every new row in your sheet sends a personalized email to the contact.
description: Handy for sending quotes, confirmations or reminders from a spreadsheet: every new row sends an email with that row's data. Map the columns in the Gmail step.

name: Weekly summary of PrestaShop orders waiting to ship
summary: Every Monday you get the list of paid orders that haven't shipped yet.
description: Every Monday Calibra looks up PrestaShop orders in the status you choose (for example "Payment accepted") and emails you how many there are, so no order is left unshipped.

name: Friendly overdue invoice reminders, written by AI
summary: Every week, AI prepares a payment reminder for your unpaid invoices.
description: Every Monday Calibra looks up unpaid invoices in Holded, AI drafts a polite reminder with the list, and sends it to you so you can review it and forward it to each customer.

name: Request the receipt for every Qonto expense
summary: Every Qonto expense without an attached invoice is emailed to you so you can upload it.
description: No more chasing receipts at the end of the quarter: when an expense without a receipt is completed in Qonto, Calibra emails you the amount, the supplier and the date so you can attach the invoice in time.

name: Qonto transactions in a spreadsheet for your accountant
summary: Every Qonto income and expense is logged in Google Sheets.
description: Share an always up-to-date transaction ledger with your accountant: every completed transaction in your Qonto account adds a row with the date, amount, counterparty, description and VAT.

name: Sendcloud shipment with label for every Shopify order
summary: Every paid order creates its shipment in Sendcloud with the label ready to print.
description: Skip copying and pasting addresses: every paid Shopify order creates the shipment in Sendcloud with the customer's details, generates the label for the carrier you choose (Correos, SEUR, GLS…) and saves it as a PDF.

name: Notify the customer when their order ships with Sendcloud
summary: When the shipment status changes, the customer gets an email with the tracking link.
description: Cut down on "where's my order?" messages: every time a Sendcloud shipment moves to the status you choose (for example, handed to the carrier), the customer gets an email with the tracking number and link.

name: PrestaShop orders to Sendcloud
summary: Every new PrestaShop order creates its shipment in Sendcloud.
description: Every new order in your PrestaShop store opens a shipment in Sendcloud with its reference, ready for you to complete the customer's address and choose the carrier.

name: Daily cash log: every SumUp payment in your spreadsheet
summary: Every payment on your SumUp card reader is logged in Google Sheets.
description: For bars, shops and freelancers: every SumUp payment adds a row with the date, amount, payment method and description, so you can balance the till and pass your sales on to your accountant.

name: SumUp payment link for every accepted quote
summary: When a customer accepts a quote, they receive a SumUp payment link.
description: Get paid sooner without chasing bank transfers: when a quote is marked as accepted (via webhook from your website or CRM), Calibra creates a SumUp payment link for the amount and emails it to the customer.

name: Personio time off announced in Slack
summary: Every new Personio absence is announced in the team channel.
description: The team knows who'll be out without having to ask: every new absence recorded in Personio shows up in Slack with the person, the type and the dates.

name: Personio new hires with a welcome and onboarding tasks
summary: Every new Personio employee gets a welcome email and their onboarding task list.
description: When you add someone in Personio, Calibra sends them a welcome email with their start date and creates a Trello card with everything that needs to be prepared.

name: WooCommerce customers to MailerLite
summary: Every new customer in your store is subscribed to a MailerLite group.
description: When someone creates an account in your WooCommerce store, Calibra adds them to the MailerLite group you choose, for your newsletters and welcome automations.

name: Google Forms subscribers to Mailrelay
summary: Every form response is subscribed to your Mailrelay group.
description: Grow your list with Mailrelay, the Spanish email marketing platform: everyone who fills in your Google form is subscribed to the group you choose. Map the email question in the Mailrelay step.

name: New MailerLite subscribers as leads in Clientify
summary: Every new MailerLite subscriber is added as a lead in Clientify.
description: Your sales team instantly sees who subscribes to the newsletter: every new MailerLite subscriber is created as a contact in Clientify with their name, company and phone.

name: Alert when someone leaves a clock-in open
summary: Every night, if a Sesame clock-in is still open, the person gets an email alert.
description: Stay compliant with Spain's mandatory working-hours log without chasing anyone: every weekday at 9:00 PM Calibra looks up Sesame clock-ins that still have no clock-out and prepares the alert for you. Set the employee, or loop through the list to alert each person.

name: Sesame vacations and time off on the team calendar
summary: Every request approved in Sesame shows up in Google Calendar.
description: When vacation or time off is approved in Sesame HR, Calibra creates the event on the shared calendar with the person and the dates, so the whole team knows who's out.

name: Missed call in Ringover: callback task and SMS to the customer
summary: Every missed call creates a task in Clientify and sends an SMS saying you'll call back.
description: Don't lose customers by missing the phone: for every missed call in Ringover, Calibra texts the customer to let them know you'll call them back and creates the task in Clientify for the sales rep.

name: Ringover call log in a spreadsheet
summary: Every Ringover call is logged in Google Sheets with its duration and outcome.
description: Analyze your phone support without exporting reports: every call that ends in Ringover adds a row with the date, direction, number, whether it was answered and how long it lasted.

name: Quipu invoices in your register with their Verifactu QR code
summary: Every new Quipu invoice gets its AEAT verification QR code and is logged in a sheet.
description: Keep your own register of issued invoices: for every new Quipu invoice, Calibra generates the verification URL and QR code from Spain's tax agency (AEAT) and saves the invoice with its QR code in Google Sheets.

name: Quipu invoice for every Stripe payment
summary: Every completed Stripe payment creates its invoice in Quipu.
description: For freelancers and small businesses that get paid through Stripe: every completed payment creates the sales invoice in Quipu with the amount and VAT, ready to review. Choose the contact and the invoice series in the Quipu step.

name: Bitrix24 leads with an instant reply and a sales rep alert
summary: Every new Bitrix24 lead gets a welcome email and the sales rep gets a Telegram message.
description: Reply to every lead within minutes: when a new lead comes into Bitrix24, Calibra sends them an email thanking them for getting in touch and alerts the sales rep on Telegram with their name, company and phone.

name: Deal won in Bitrix24: draft invoice in Holded
summary: When you win a deal in Bitrix24, a draft invoice is created in Holded.
description: Connect sales and invoicing: when a deal moves to won in Bitrix24, Calibra creates a draft invoice in Holded for the deal amount so you can review and issue it.

name: Teamtailor applications announced in Slack
summary: Every new application to a job opening is announced in the recruiting channel.
description: The recruiting team instantly sees who has applied: every new application in Teamtailor shows up in Slack with the candidate's name, the job and the source.

name: Eventbrite attendees to your Mailchimp list
summary: Everyone who buys a ticket on Eventbrite is added to Mailchimp.
description: For training schools, associations and event organizers: every new attendee at your Eventbrite events is subscribed to the Mailchimp audience you choose, with their first and last name.

name: Ask for a review when AfterShip marks the order as delivered
summary: When a shipment is delivered, the customer gets an email asking for their feedback.
description: The best time to ask for a review is right after the order arrives: when AfterShip marks a shipment as delivered, Calibra waits a day and emails the customer a link to rate their purchase.

name: Instant alerts for AfterShip shipping issues
summary: If a shipment has an exception or a failed delivery attempt, the team finds out in Slack.
description: Get ahead of complaints: when AfterShip detects an exception, a failed delivery attempt or an expired shipment, Calibra posts an alert in Slack with the order, the customer and the carrier so you can handle it before they write in.

name: Wix store: Holded invoice for every order
summary: Every new order in your Wix store creates its invoice in Holded.
description: Every new Wix Stores order creates the invoice in Holded with the order total and the customer's details, ready to send.

name: Your Wix website forms as contacts in Clientify
summary: Every Wix form submission creates the contact in Clientify.
description: Messages sent through the form on your Wix website go straight into your CRM: Calibra creates the contact in Clientify with their name, email and message.

name: Printful: notify the customer when their order ships
summary: When Printful ships an order, the customer gets an email with tracking.
description: For print-on-demand stores: when Printful marks an order as shipped, Calibra emails the customer so they know their order is on its way.

name: Legally valid notices by Lleida.net certified SMS
summary: Sends a certified SMS with proof of delivery for important notices.
description: For real estate agencies, law firms and property managers: when a notice arrives via webhook (missed payment, meeting notice, end of contract), Calibra sends it as a Lleida.net certified SMS, which sends you a legally valid delivery certificate.

name: WhatsApp order confirmation with Infobip
summary: Every new WooCommerce order gets a WhatsApp confirmation template.
description: Your customers read WhatsApp more than email: every new WooCommerce order sends the confirmation template approved in your Infobip account with the order number.

name: Shipped ShipStation orders in a spreadsheet
summary: Every order shipped from ShipStation is logged in Google Sheets.
description: Keep track of the day's shipments without opening ShipStation: every order that moves to shipped adds a row with the order, customer, store and date.

name: Real estate: book every viewing and confirm it to the prospect
summary: Every viewing request creates the event in Google Calendar and the prospect gets an email confirmation.
description: Connect the viewing form on your website or listing portal to the webhook (fields nombre, email, telefono, inmueble, direccion, fecha_inicio and fecha_fin in ISO format). Calibra creates the viewing in the agent's calendar with the property address and emails the prospect the day and time. Review the email text before turning it on.

name: Real estate: alert the agent two hours before every viewing
summary: The agent gets a Telegram summary of every viewing in their calendar two hours ahead.
description: So nobody is late to a viewing: two hours before every event in the chosen calendar, Calibra sends the agent the title, address and event link on Telegram. Use a calendar that only holds viewings.

name: Real estate: a record for every owner who wants to sell
summary: Every valuation request is organised with AI, added to Google Sheets and sent to the listings team.
description: Connect your "What is my home worth?" form to the webhook (fields nombre, email, telefono and mensaje). AI pulls the property type, area, size and selling timeline out of the message, Calibra adds it to your listings sheet and alerts the team on Slack. Map the sheet columns when you set it up.

name: Real estate: a second email to the prospect after two days
summary: Two days after every property inquiry, the prospect gets a follow-up email.
description: Many prospects do not answer the first contact. Connect your form or listing portal to the webhook (fields nombre, email and inmueble): Calibra waits two days and sends a follow-up email offering a viewing or similar properties. If you have already talked, adjust the wait or turn it off.

name: Clinic: confirmation and instructions when an appointment is booked
summary: Every Calendly booking gets an email with the pre-visit instructions and is logged in your sheet.
description: When a patient books on Calendly, Calibra emails them what to bring and how to reschedule, and logs the booking in Google Sheets for the front desk. Write your own instructions in the email before turning it on and do not include clinical data.

name: Clinic: alert the front desk when a slot frees up
summary: When a patient cancels on Calendly, the front desk is alerted to offer the slot to the waiting list.
description: An empty slot nobody fills is lost revenue. Every Calendly cancellation sends the front desk a Telegram message with the patient and the reason, so they can call whoever is on the waiting list.

name: Clinic: sort your patients' feedback with AI
summary: Every satisfaction survey answer is classified with AI so complaints reach the manager straight away.
description: Connect your survey to the webhook (fields nombre and comentario). AI labels each answer as positive, neutral or complaint and Calibra posts it to the clinic manager's Slack channel with the label, so complaints get answered first. Do not ask for health data in the survey.

name: Restaurant: every booking in the calendar with a confirmation
summary: Bookings from your website go into Google Calendar and the guest gets an email confirmation.
description: Connect your website booking form to the webhook (fields nombre, email, telefono, personas, fecha_inicio and fecha_fin in ISO format). Calibra adds the booking to the dining room calendar with the party size and emails the guest a confirmation. Adjust the text to your cancellation policy.

name: Hospitality: alert the manager about every Google review
summary: Every new review on your Google profile reaches the manager on Telegram with a summary and a suggested reply.
description: So no review goes unanswered: when a review arrives on your Google Business Profile, AI summarises it and suggests a reply, and Calibra sends both to the manager on Telegram. The reply is not published automatically: the manager decides.

name: Hospitality: today's bookings on Telegram every morning
summary: Every morning the team gets a Telegram summary of today's bookings from your calendar.
description: Every day at 10:00 Calibra reads the events in your bookings calendar, AI sorts them by time with the party size and the team gets the summary on Telegram. In the Google Calendar step, choose the bookings calendar and today's range.

name: Academy: register and welcome every new student
summary: Every sign-up from your website is logged in Google Sheets and the student gets a welcome email.
description: Connect your sign-up form to the webhook (fields nombre, email and curso). Calibra adds the student to your enrolment sheet and sends a welcome email with the next steps. Map the sheet columns and write your own next steps in the email.

name: Academy: remind the group one hour before every class
summary: One hour before every class in your calendar, the Telegram group gets a reminder with the link.
description: One hour before every event in the classes calendar, Calibra sends the students' Telegram group the class name, the place or link and the time. Use a calendar that only holds classes and add the Telegram bot to the group.

name: Weekly AI-written summary of your Meta ads in Slack
summary: Every Monday AI reviews last week's Facebook and Instagram campaigns and posts a summary in Slack.
description: Every Monday at 9:00 it reads last week's results (Monday to Sunday) for each Meta Ads campaign: spend, impressions, reach, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions and ROAS. AI turns them into a clear summary of what worked, what didn't and three concrete recommendations, and posts it in the Slack channel you choose. It only reads data: it never pauses campaigns or changes budgets. Connect your ad account and pick the channel in the last step.

name: Recharge cancellation: AI prepares the email to win the customer back
summary: When someone cancels their subscription, AI writes a win-back email based on the cancellation reason and sends it to you to review.
description: Every subscription cancelled in Recharge comes with the product and the cancellation reason. AI writes a win-back email tailored to that reason (if they have too much product, it suggests spacing out or skipping deliveries; if it's about price, it reminds them of the value without promising discounts) and emails it to you with the Recharge customer ID, so you can review it and send it yourself. It never cancels, reactivates or charges anything. Add your email in the last step and adjust the tone in the AI step.

name: Log every Paystack payment in Google Sheets
summary: Every completed Paystack payment is added as a new row in your payments sheet.
description: Keep your payments log up to date without copying anything by hand: every completed Paystack payment adds a row with payment date, reference, customer, email, amount, fee, currency and payment channel. Create a sheet with those columns in that order (A to H) and pick it in the Google Sheets step. It only reads payments: it never charges or refunds anything.

name: Slack alert for every outgoing payment in Mercury
summary: Every payment or charge leaving your Mercury accounts is posted in Slack right away.
description: Keep an eye on spending without logging in to the bank: every outgoing transaction in your Mercury accounts (transfers, cards, direct debits) is posted in the Slack channel you choose with the amount, who it goes to, the description, the status and a link to the transaction. In the trigger you can limit it to certain accounts or statuses, or change the direction to be alerted of incoming payments too. It only reads transactions: it never moves money.

name: Send customers their tracking link when ShipBob ships the order
summary: When ShipBob ships an order, the customer gets an email with the carrier and the tracking link.
description: Fewer "where is my order?" emails: as soon as a ShipBob shipment has a tracking number, Calibra emails the customer the order number, the carrier and the tracking link. Check the subject and signature in the Gmail step.

name: Ask for a review when EasyPost marks the shipment as delivered
summary: One day after delivery, the customer gets an email asking for their feedback.
description: The best time to ask for a review is right after the order arrives: when an EasyPost tracker moves to delivered, Calibra waits a day, looks up the shipment by its tracking number in your Google Sheets orders sheet and emails the customer asking for their feedback. Your sheet needs the tracking number in column A, the customer email in column B and their name in column C. Replace [link to your reviews] with your Google, Trustpilot or shop link.

name: Messenger messages sorted by AI with a team alert in Slack
summary: Every new message to your Facebook Page is classified by AI and reaches Slack with a suggested reply.
description: Never leave a message unanswered: every new message your Facebook Page receives in Messenger is classified by AI (question, order, issue, quote, complaint, spam or other), AI suggests a reply and the team gets an alert in Slack with the message, the type and the suggestion so they can answer from Meta Business Suite. It never replies to the customer automatically. Edit the rules in the AI step with your hours and policies.

name: Post an AI-written Threads post every weekday from your ideas sheet
summary: Every morning AI takes the next idea from your Google Sheet, writes the post and publishes it on Threads.
description: Keep your Threads profile active without thinking about what to write every day: list your ideas in a Google Sheet, one per row in column A, with a title in row 1. Every weekday at 10:00 Calibra picks the next idea, AI writes a short, natural post under 500 characters and publishes it on your profile. Calibra remembers where it left off, so each idea is posted only once; when ideas run out it posts a question to your followers, so add ideas ahead of time. Adjust your brand's tone in the AI step.

name: Slack alert for every new deal in Productive
summary: Whenever someone creates a deal in Productive, the team sees it in Slack right away.
description: Keep the whole team aware of what's entering the pipeline: every new sales deal created in Productive is posted in the Slack channel you choose with its name, number, probability, expected close date and currency. In the trigger you can change the type to be alerted of budgets too.

name: Generate product images with Ideogram from your Google Sheet
summary: Every new product you add to your sheet becomes an image for your shop or social media, delivered to Slack.
description: For shops that need images fast: add a row to your sheet with the product name in column A and a short description in column B (style, colours, use). Calibra asks Ideogram for a square, product-photo style image and posts it in the Slack channel you choose so the team can review and download it. Adjust the style in the Ideogram step prompt. Each image uses credits from your Ideogram account.
